svg.title: Octobot 2.0 VEGA Executor Architecture
svg.desc: High-level architecture for the live VEGA chatbot. Inside the Citi network, the VEGA experience consumes executor services provided by the Services AI Team, including orchestration, specialist execution, final formatting, governed MCP tool access, R2D2 model access, shared data services, platform infrastructure, and user feedback. The root orchestrator routes Asset Services and Transaction Management requests to five active MCP tools.

g.text: Live AS + TM operations chatbot using executor and platform services provided by the Services AI Team
OPS UI TEAM - LIVE CHAT EXPERIENCE
ALL EXECUTOR SERVICES PROVIDED BY SERVICES AI TEAM
Independent AS / TM execution; BOTH supported
TYPED VALIDATION, FIELD MAPPING, AUTH AND SAFE ERRORS
MODEL ACCESS ONLY - NO PROVIDER DATA
PLATFORM CAPABILITIES - NOT ALL REQUIRED BY EVERY USE CASE
State owned by the live chat experience
Supports history, continuity and scoped sessions
BFF-MANAGED STATE - OUTSIDE THE SERVICES AI EXECUTOR PLATFORM
Shared capabilities are outside the live business-tool path unless selected by the use case.
Response: provider result - MCP normalization - specialists - formatter - BFF/SSE - UI
